description: Welcome to 10926 Bluffside Dr. Unit 3, a stylish, light-filled townhouse-style (no one above nor below) condo with a loft + a vibe that combines comfort and sophistication, with livability and convenience. This updated 1-bedroom, 1.5-bath unit spans 1,094 sq ft and is perched above a tree-lined street, while only steps from iconic Ventura Blvd. Inside you will find an open living area with rich wood floors, custom wood throughout, and a fireplace that not only sets the tone, but truly sets this home apart. The tastefully reimagined kitchen features butcher block countertops, dishwasher, gas cooktop, custom (real) wood cabinetry with maximized storage, and a stunning resin breakfast bar - perfect for entertaining or casual dining. Upstairs, the primary retreat boasts vaulted ceilings, a second fireplace, reading nook, desk area (over an interior balcony overlook), retractable television, two closets (one walk-in), and a spa-like en-suite bath. Further highlights include central AC/heat, in-unit laundry, multiple storage closets, and a private patio overlooking the tree-lined street. This well-managed building offers resort-style amenities including: a heated pool, spa, dual saunas, fitness center, laundry facility, and community room. Two tandem parking spaces and a large storage locker in the gated subterranean garage complete the package. Experience a retreat unlike any other, combining Studio City dining, shopping, and entertainment - with effortless connectivity to everything LA has to offer!
